sentences.en: Marriage succeeds only as lifetime commitment with no escape clauses.
sentences.zh: 婚姻的成功在于它是一生的承诺，没有逃脱的条款。

sentences.en: This corpus is just a giant compilation of independent clauses.
sentences.zh: 这个语料库仅仅是一个由独立分句组成的巨大汇编。

sentences.en: A clause is composed of a subject and a predicate.
sentences.zh: 一个从句是由主语和谓语构成的。
